author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before: a short U-shaped hairpin with a round bend and nearly parallel arms, reading as a hair pin or paper clip. After: two long straight arms from a pointed hinge in the bottom-left corner opening at a narrow angle to the top-right, which matches the reference's long slim tweezers.
omissions: The reference's thin outlined blades are single strokes; the slight grip kink on the upper arm is left out.
